# Move outsourced coating around a supplier outage — operating control

Scope: Recover constrained production with approved work-center, labor, tooling, and timing decisions.

The operator must reconcile the authoritative ERP record with the named collaboration and document evidence. A write is permitted only after the record identity, effective revision, quantity or amount, and recorded approval agree. Preserve task, lot, serial, supplier, project, and work-order references. Communicate the resulting identifier and effective date; never infer approval from silence.

instruction: You are the manufacturing scheduler for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-018 (Move outsourced coating around a supplier outage). Reconcile the supplier notice, open PO line, and qualified alternate before revising the outside-processing resource. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, write the outcome into the existing control-workbook cell; then create the requested email draft without sending it. Return exactly: affected_order, recovery_route, revised_completion.
